statements: Customers upload a bundle of templates, a JSON list of { path, content } entries, with content in base64. Add extractBundle(bundle, dest) to src/bundles.mjs, which writes the files under the folder dest, creating folders as needed. It returns the number of files written.
A bundle the service will not take throws HttpError 400 with code invalid_bundle.
A bundle goes in completely or not at all. Limits are in src/config.mjs.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add bundle extraction to the templates service, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
